name: seatlock
description: Flash-sale ticketing platform with event-driven microservices

scripts.build: npm run build -w @seatlock/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n inventory,order,payment,notification,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @seatlock/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/order-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/web"
scripts.dev:services: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n inventory,order,payment,notification -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @seatlock/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/order-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @seatlock/notification-service"
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate -w @seatlock/inventory-service && npm run migrate -w @seatlock/order-service && npm run migrate -w @seatlock/payment-service && npm run migrate -w @seatlock/notification-service
